discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 239/263, reusing their keys; 30 search snippets (Disney Pins Blog, Pink a la Mode listings, Disney Pin Forum, My Pin Central). New sets: NBC Dec 2021, Robin Hood mystery and Disney Poster blind box Feb 2022, NBC Gothic Sept 2022. Robin Hood 8 regular designs added. Turning Red 4*Town and Friends listings added under holds. No holds released; one new duplicate hold (Wave 1 Maleficent/Aurora). Pink a la Mode retailer only; no manufacturer claims.
